Subject: CAIQ evidence: provenance & third-party dependencies

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's runtime topology last week. As we prepare our vendor assessment, the CAIQ reviewer has pushed back on a couple of items where we need clearer provenance for evidence artifacts:

- Mapping of CAIQ control SLRs to the specific artifacts (logs, attestations, runbooks) showing who produced them and when.
- Third-party dependency lineage for components in the inference path (model hosting, KV cache, telemetry ingestion) with version stamps and vendor attestations.

Could you provide a short deliverable that: (1) lists each CAIQ control we claim, the artifact(s) that demonstrate compliance, and the artifact provenance chain (author/owner, creation date, storage location), and (2) an inventory of third-party dependencies tied to controls with any available vendor attestations? A sample CSV or spreadsheet would be ideal.

Target timeline: 10 business days if possible. We are starting our security review on Sep 2.

Thanks,
Alyssa Reed
Security Manager, BrightFin
security@brightfin.com

- CAIQ_provenance_matrix.xlsx (rows: CAIQ control, claimed status, artifact filename, artifact owner, artifact creation date, storage link, provenance note)
